marquee.text: Founded by Late Nazar Hussain Alvi
Main Campus: Qila Didar Singh Gujranwala

founder.name: Nazar Hussain Alvi
founder.title: Late Founder & Visionary Patron
founder.urduTitle: بانیِ ادارہ: محترم نذر حسین علوی (مرحوم)
founder.quote: Serving humanity in distress is the highest form of worship. Our doors must always remain open to the needy.
founder.bio: The benevolent founder whose compassion and devotion laid the cornerstone of Ali Welfare Trust Hospital in 2005, ensuring that no patient in Qila Didar Singh and surrounding villages is ever denied world-class healthcare due to lack of funds.

memorialPillars.title: Foundation of Compassion (2005)
memorialPillars.desc: Established with a solemn pledge that financial constraints should never prevent a human being from receiving dignified healthcare.

memorialPillars.title: Free Dialysis & Eye Care Legacy
memorialPillars.desc: Pioneered community welfare health camps, subsidized dialysis programs, and free cataract eye surgeries across Gujranwala district.

memorialPillars.title: Perpetual Sadqah-e-Jariyah
memorialPillars.desc: Operating purely on non-profit principles with transparent zakat governance and audited community trust accountability.

executiveTeam.name: Nazar Hussain Alvi
executiveTeam.title: Late Founder & Visionary Patron
executiveTeam.bio: The benevolent founder whose compassion and devotion laid the cornerstone of Ali Welfare Trust Hospital in 2005, ensuring that no patient in Qila Didar Singh and surrounding villages is ever denied world-class healthcare due to lack of funds.
executiveTeam.quote: Serving humanity in distress is the highest form of worship. Our doors must always remain open to the needy.

executiveTeam.name: Zamin Ali Alvi
executiveTeam.title: Chairman & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
executiveTeam.bio: Under his dynamic executive leadership, the hospital has expanded into a multi-specialty institution featuring state-of-the-art dialysis suites, digital radiology, advanced eye care theater, and free medicine distribution programs.
executiveTeam.quote: Our relentless commitment is to blend clinical excellence with heartfelt empathy for every single patient.

executiveTeam.name: Khawar Abbas Awan
executiveTeam.title: Hospital Director
executiveTeam.bio: Spearheading administrative operational excellence, welfare outreach programs, community health camps, and modern infrastructure enhancements across all inpatient and outpatient departments.
executiveTeam.quote: Every donation and every effort is dedicated transparently towards saving human lives and alleviating pain.

mission.missionEn: To provide accessible and compassionate healthcare, ensuring high-quality medical services for our community, regardless of circumstances.
mission.missionUrdu: معاشرے کے ہر فرد کو بلا تفریق معیاری، سستی اور ہمدردانہ طبی سہولیات کی فراہمی
mission.visionEn: To be a leading healthcare institution known for excellence in patient care and community service, creating a healthier society through innovation and empowerment.
mission.visionUrdu: صحت عامہ میں جدت، بہترین نگہداشت اور بے لوث خدمت کے ذریعے ایک صحت مند معاشرے کی تشکیل

pillars.title: Compassionate Care
pillars.desc: Treating every patient with dignity, warmth, and clinical sensitivity regardless of socioeconomic standing.

pillars.title: Clinical Excellence
pillars.desc: Modern diagnostic imaging, international sterilization protocols, and qualified medical specialists.

pillars.title: Transparent Welfare
pillars.desc: Every rupee of Zakat and Sadqah directly utilized for patient treatments, dialysis sessions, and free medicine.

departments.name: Kidney Dialysis Center
departments.shortDesc: Advanced German-standard hemodialysis machines delivering free & subsidized life-saving renal care.
departments.fullDesc: Our dedicated Kidney Dialysis Unit provides round-the-clock hemodialysis supervised by experienced nephrologists and certified dialysis technicians. Complete with dedicated water treatment plant, strict sterilization protocols, and emergency backup.
features: Dedicated Hepatitis B & C Separate Units

departments.name: Eye Care & Ophthalmology
departments.shortDesc: Modern phaco cataract surgeries, computer vision testing, and cornea diagnostics.
departments.fullDesc: Equipped with state-of-the-art ophthalmic surgical microscopes, phacoemulsification systems, auto-refractometers, and slit lamps. We organize frequent free cataract surgery camps for rural elderly citizens.
features: Free Lens Implantation for Needy Patients

departments.name: General & Internal Medicine
departments.urduName: شعبہ میڈیسن و جنرل او پی ڈی
departments.shortDesc: Comprehensive clinical consultations for chronic, acute, and complex adult illnesses.
departments.fullDesc: Experienced physicians managing diabetes, hypertension, cardiovascular risks, gastrointestinal disorders, infectious diseases, respiratory conditions, and geriatric health.

departments.name: Radiology & Color Doppler
departments.shortDesc: High-resolution 4D Ultrasound, Color Doppler, Digital X-Rays, and precise imaging.
departments.fullDesc: State-of-the-art diagnostic imaging providing immediate, crystal-clear imaging reports. Operated by licensed radiologists and sonologists for obstetric, abdominal, musculoskeletal, and vascular scans.

departments.name: Gynecology & Obstetrics
departments.shortDesc: Safe deliveries, prenatal and postnatal maternal care, and female reproductive health.
departments.fullDesc: Dedicated labor rooms, modern neonatal resuscitation setup, experienced female gynecologists and trained lady health visitors ensuring safe child delivery and respectful mother-infant care.

departments.name: Laboratory & Diagnostics
departments.shortDesc: Automated hematology, clinical chemistry, hormone assays, and serology testing.
departments.fullDesc: Precision laboratory utilizing fully automated analyzers with stringent external quality control. Rapid turnaround time for emergency blood counts, cardiac markers, renal function, and viral screenings.
features: Hepatitis B & C Rapid & ELISA Screening
Free Lab Testing for Zakat Beneficiaries

departments.name: Urology & Stone Care
departments.shortDesc: Specialized management of kidney stones, prostate disorders, and urinary tract health.
departments.fullDesc: Advanced diagnostics and surgical care for renal calculi, benign prostatic hyperplasia, urinary tract infections, and congenital abnormalities with minimally invasive procedures.

departments.name: 24/7 Emergency & Trauma
departments.shortDesc: Rapid response trauma unit with oxygen manifold, cardiac monitors, and resuscitation beds.
departments.fullDesc: Uninterrupted 24/7 trauma and acute care reception capable of stabilizing accidents, cardiac crises, acute respiratory failure, and medical emergencies immediately upon arrival.

departments.name: In-House Welfare Pharmacy
departments.shortDesc: Quality certified medicines available 24/7, with subsidized and free medicine dispensation.
departments.fullDesc: Clean, temperature-controlled pharmacy stocking 100% authentic pharmaceuticals directly from approved manufacturers. Free medication dispensed to eligible needy patients on doctor prescription.

departments.name: Ear, Nose & Throat (ENT)
departments.shortDesc: Comprehensive diagnostics and treatments for ear infections, sinus conditions, and throat disorders.
departments.fullDesc: Equipped with modern diagnostic otoscopes, audiometry screening, and specialized ENT clinic offering patient-first solutions for hearing, nasal breathing, and throat health.

departments.name: Orthopaedics & Family Medicine
departments.shortDesc: Joint pain, fractures, arthritis management, and full-spectrum family healthcare.
departments.fullDesc: Dedicated orthopaedic and family medicine consultation offering advanced bone, joint, and spine evaluations alongside everyday medical triage for all family members.

departments.name: Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation
departments.shortDesc: Targeted physical rehabilitation for stroke recovery, chronic joint pain, and mobility restoration.
departments.fullDesc: Modern physiotherapy unit equipped with ultrasonic therapy, TENS, cervical-lumbar traction, and tailored kinesiology exercise regimens under expert physiotherapist supervision.

departments.name: Neurosurgery & Spine Care
departments.urduName: شعبہ نیورو سرجری و مہرہ جات
departments.shortDesc: Specialist neurosurgical consultations for brain disorders, spinal disc compression, and nerve health.
departments.fullDesc: Expert neurosurgical evaluations offering comprehensive clinical assessment for disc herniation, traumatic brain injury follow-up, peripheral neuropathy, and neurological diseases.

departments.name: Pulmonology & Chest Medicine
departments.shortDesc: Specialized care for asthma, chronic bronchitis, COPD, tuberculosis, and chest infections.
departments.fullDesc: Dedicated chest medicine clinic with nebulization suites, spirometry assessments, and personalized therapy plans for respiratory health and lung recovery.

departments.name: Pediatrics & Child Healthcare
departments.urduName: شعبہ اطفال و نگہداشتِ نو مولود
departments.shortDesc: Comprehensive infant, child, and adolescent healthcare, growth monitoring, and immunization.
departments.fullDesc: Gentle and compassionate pediatric care focusing on newborn health, childhood infections, nutritional advice, vaccination, and developmental screening.

departments.name: Gastroenterology & Hepatology
departments.urduName: شعبہ امراض معدہ، جگر و آنت
departments.shortDesc: Specialist consultations for liver diseases, hepatitis, ulcers, acid reflux, and digestive issues.
departments.fullDesc: Clinical gastrointestinal consultation addressing peptic ulcer disease, GERD, hepatitis management, IBS, and chronic abdominal pain under specialist guidance.

departments.name: General & Laparoscopic Surgery
departments.shortDesc: Expert surgical consultations, minor and major operative procedures, and post-operative recovery.
departments.fullDesc: Modern surgical department performing hernia repairs, appendectomy, gallbladder care, abscess drainage, and diabetic foot management with sterile operation theaters.

causes.title: Sponsor a Dialysis Session
causes.urduTitle: ایک مریض کا ڈائلیسز سیشن سپانسر کریں
causes.description: Provide a life-saving hemodialysis session including dialyzer, heparin, saline, and specialist nursing for a poor renal patient.
causes.impactNote: 1 dialysis session extends a kidney patient's life by 3 to 4 days.

causes.title: Free Eye Cataract Surgery (Phaco)
causes.description: Restore sight for an elderly grandmother or grandfather with stitchless phacoemulsification and imported intraocular lens.
causes.impactNote: Restores clear eyesight and independence for life.

causes.title: Patient Free Medicine Fund
causes.urduTitle: غریب مریضوں کی مفت ادویات کا فنڈ
causes.description: Support monthly life-saving heart, diabetes, and antibiotic treatments for patients who cannot afford pharmacy bills.
causes.impactNote: Supplies essential prescription medicines for an entire month.

causes.title: 24/7 Emergency & Ambulance Fund
causes.description: Fund life-saving oxygen cylinders, emergency trauma resuscitation kits, and rapid rural patient transfers.
causes.impactNote: Keeps rapid response ambulances fueled and ready 24/7.
